changedScope: Only the released-adapter-service-integration gate can use an exact Runner-owned harness execution in addition to the existing Prism-owned harness. Required gate identities, model/adapter/worker settings and requirements are unchanged.
checksPreserved: Every other gate still requires its original owning repository and revision binding.
Service execution still binds the exact serviceHarnessRevision on refs/heads/main, positive run/attempt, native ARM64 Snapdragon family/processor and independent reviewer identity.
The selected tested runtime still requires matching version/revision, archive SHA-256, server SHA-256 and worker SHA-256 rather than treating the harness source as the runtime source.
The retained harness package still requires bounded external regular-file bytes and an exact SHA-256. Missing or altered package data rejects.
A Runner execution with a Prism workflow or artifact family rejects; the reverse mixed family rejects too. Unsupported repositories and wrong run or attempt reject.
Policy includes the two explicit provenance families, changing its raw computed digest. A historical policy or score must not be copied or relabelled as a score under the new policy.
Output records executionRepository separately from the gate's owning repository. A genuine Runner execution is never presented as an executed Prism workflow.

reviewedSourceRegressions.scope: Source inspection only. The new positive case leaves all other PTQ1 gates pending and promotionReady false; mutation cases reject repository/workflow/artifact cross-pairing, stale harness revision, missing runtime/file identities and tampering. Existing Prism-family positive handling remains required.

evidenceBoundary: This evaluator checks bounded file integrity and independently reviewed attestations. It does not itself authenticate GitHub metadata, inspect a model, replace independent retained-data review or promote a default. The exact hosted source-built evaluator must pass owning checks before scoring real evidence.
